annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that if a ClientHello spans multiple Initial packets, servers may use the Retry feature to buffer partial ClientHello messages only from clients whose address has been validated. The use of MAY is discretionary, not ambiguous, and no other part of the clause leaves implementation behavior undefined.
